category: free anonymous premium-link generator with torrent seedbox and a public API

free_tier.stated: 'No Sign Up Required  Completely Free', 'We are a 100% free premium link generator. You can bypass file host limits and enjoy premium link downloads without any hidden fees or subscriptions.'
free_tier.notes: No counter is published; 'unlimited' is the vendor's word.

per_object_cap.stated: 'Unlimited & No File Size Limit' - no number

egress.terms: 'Full Speed Download ... no waiting time'; no quota language and no price.

interface_detail: 'Developer API: Build your own tools using our robust free premium link generator API', plus a browser add-on and a JDownloader plugin.
endpoint: not published on the home page
tooling: JDownloader plugin, browser extension and a documented-as-existing API; the endpoint itself is not on the page a reader can reach.
chaining: It is the only anonymous free generator that claims both torrent seedbox and an API, which is what a scripted client needs; whether the API answers is untested.
limits_note: No numeric limit anywhere on the page; the API's rate limit is the thing a scripted client would hit first and it is not published.
binding_note: Inferred: with no account and no published counter, the only mechanism left is per-caller shaping. Recorded as inference, not as a vendor statement.

identity_cost.detail: 'No accounts, no logins' - the generator takes a URL and returns a link.

reliability_note: A free service claiming torrent seeding, an API and no limits, with no status page and no host count, is the profile that disappears without notice; generated-link lifetime is not stated.
confidence_note: The free claim, the no-signup claim, the torrent/seedbox block and the API claim are vendor-stated and read today. Nothing was called, so 'API exists' is a vendor claim, not a measured one.

evidence.proved: 'No Sign Up Required', 'premium link generator with torrent support and an integrated debrid seedbox', 'Developer API', 'no file size limit'

notes: The API claim is the interesting one: a free, keyless REST endpoint that also seeds torrents would be the cheapest programmatic path in the whole topic. It is recorded as a claim because no endpoint is published and none was called. The site also says 'free ... without any hidden fees or subscriptions', which rules out a paid tier to fall back on.
